_comment: Which age group each public ticket type admits, for the dashboard's "people coming" figures. Ticket type ids come from scripts/tt-ticket-types.mjs. Every public type is listed, adults included, so the dashboard's unmapped notice fires only for a type nobody has accounted for yet: a type that falls through to the default silently is the case that notice exists for. Team pass types (TT_TYPE_*) are never public and are never in these counts.
